title: Dev Plaque
body:
The Dev Plaque is an object that you can get in Daily Rewards

Details

Dev Plaque is an plaque that shows an Oaklands developer whit unique nummber.

  • Oaklands Developer on plaque are randomized.
  • Nummber on plaque is unique and shows how rare is your plaque.

Obtaining

To get Dev Plaque you must have 5 login tokens. To get login tokens you must

claim daily rewards.
